title: Marketing Officer
description:
ROLE DESCRIPTION

As Marketing Officer, you will report to our External Relations Manager, playing a central role in driving Get Further's visibility and growth through maintaining our digital platforms and driving campaigns focused on forming and retaining partnerships.

You will help Get Further to reach more students by designing and delivering creative multi-channel B2 B marketing campaigns that promote our tuition programmes, CPD and curriculum resources to FE colleges, training providers and councils.

You will also be responsible for the day-to-day delivery and maintenance of our digital channels, creating compelling written, graphic, photographic and video content, managing our website and email marketing, and using analytics to refine and strengthen performance.

Alongside digital delivery, you will contribute to our wider work by creating collateral for and supporting with the delivery of conferences and events, sourcing stories from the students and teachers we support, collaborating with our fundraising and recruitment teams on their campaigns, and supporting our wider team to deliver impactful and brand aligned external communications.

Key responsibilities include:

Marketing Campaigns & Partnerships
- Plan and deliver multichannel B2 B marketing campaigns that attract new partners and support renewals, using social media (primarily LinkedIn), email marketing, letter campaigns and other channels creatively and strategically.
- Use audience maps, value propositions and key messaging guides to tailor content to our different audiences (FE colleges, training providers and councils), ensuring alignment with the Get Further brand.
- Lead the creation of high quality marketing collateral (leaflets, banners, videos, case studies, graphics) that strengthens our brand and supports direct sales.
- Support the planning and delivery of events and campaigns that showcase Get Further's mission, impact and thought leadership.
- Use a marketing funnel to track and analyse lead generation and conversion, making data-driven recommendations that allow the marketing and sales teams to improve processes.
- Coordinate award submissions that raise the organisation's profile, working with colleagues to compile compelling applications.

Digital Content & Platform Management
- Plan and deliver high quality, creative social media content and campaigns that advance our digital strategy and deepen audience engagement.
- Design engaging graphic and video assets using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite and other tools.
- Capture high quality photo and video content of events and programmes in action.
- Maintain and update the Get Further website, using WordPress to optimise content, improve user experience and reflect organisational priorities.
- Support with the creation and publication of blog content, including drafting, editing, proofreading and uploading posts.
- Track and analyse the performance of digital content and campaigns, using analytics tools to generate insights and recommend data driven improvements.
- Play an active role in shaping our digital content strategy - identifying new opportunities, spotting trends in audience behaviour, and proposing creative approaches to strengthen engagement and reach.

Storytelling and impact reporting
- Support the promotion of Get Further's impact reports through digital content and event delivery.
- Work with colleagues to source powerful stories from students and teachers, developing and ensuring all content aligns with our ethical storytelling policy

Branding & Team Support
- Assist colleagues with the design of external documents and assets, ensuring they are user friendly, professional and aligned with brand guidelines.
- Create and maintain written guides, templates, trainings and brand tools that help the team communicate consistently and confidently.
- Respond to internal requests for branding and communication support.
- Work with the Fundraising Officer to maintain an organised central library of storytelling assets, including narrative content, photos and videos.
- Support recruitment campaigns by creating content that showcases the benefits of working at Get Further.

Person specification

We are seeking a highly-motivated, detail-oriented and creative Marketing Officer who is eager to progress their career in education charity communications.

You will be a compelling storyteller who cares deeply about communicating the experiences of the young people and adults we support, and has a strong set of written, video editing and design skills that enable you to tell these stories with clarity and impact.

You will be ambitious to take on a leading role in driving our marketing activities, proactively generating and sharing ideas, and bringing a strong set of project management skills that enable you to take ownership on campaigns - from concept, to delivery to evaluation.

You will take pride in delivering excellent campaigns and eager to continuously learn and improve. You will have a critical eye for your own work, double and triple checking every aspect to ensure high-quality output, proactively seeking feedback and setting aside time to reflect and evaluate within a busy workload. You will be confident using data to understand performance and analytically minded in using insights to improve both your work and make recommendations for how the wider organisation can improve our strategy and processes.

You will be curious to learn about our organisation and audiences, proactively seeking opportunities to learn more about who we are and what we do so that you can communicate about our work to the highest standard and develop a coherent strategic vision for our marketing work.

Your strong time management skills will mean that you are comfortable working at pace and have the agility to respond to changing priorities and contexts.

For the right candidate, this role offers meaningful opportunities to develop new and existing skills, take on additional responsibilities, and progress internally as you help shape and deliver impactful marketing campaigns that benefit the young people and adults we support.

How to apply

Your application must include:
- A CV of no more than 2 sides of A4; and
- A supporting statement which includes your answers to the following three questions:
- Why do you want to work for Get Further? (250 words);
- For the following three areas of the "Role Description" section of the job specification, outline which of your projects/work to date demonstrates that you would be successful in this role:
- Marketing campaigns & partnerships
- Digital content & platform management
- Branding & team support
- If your application is successful, what two aspects of the role would be the biggest challenge for you, and how would you overcome these challenges? (300 words)

Please submit your application via our website by 9am on Thursday 10 September.Incomplete applications will not be processed.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first-round interview taking place in the morning on the 15, 16 and 17 of September.

Second round interviews will take place week commencing 21 September.

title: Marketing Science Lead
description:
As Media Measurement Lead, you will be Sky's senior technical owner for media measurement standards, responsible for building and embedding a unified measurement framework across ATL, digital, testing, econometrics and campaign reporting.

You will define the KPIs, methodology principles, evidential standards and confidence thresholds that determine how media performance is assessed, ensuring different evidence sources are interpreted consistently and used for the right decisions.

A core part of the role is designing and delivering robust strategic geo-tests and other incrementality experiments that provide credible evidence on what drives growth. You will lead the technical design of these tests end-to-end, from feasibility, market selection, power and KPI definition through to evaluation, interpretation and recommendation.

Reporting into the Head of Media Effectiveness, you will work closely with Econometrics, Digital Marketing, Media Planning, Media Strategy, Test & Learn and Publicis to connect measurement approaches into one practical framework for investment decision-making. This is a highly technical leadership role: the successful candidate will combine advanced statistical thinking, hands-on data capability and strong commercial judgement to protect the integrity of evidence while enabling confident media investment decisions.

What you'll do
- Own Sky's end-to-end media measurement framework, defining KPI standards, methodological principles, evidential standards and the measurement approaches used to evaluate media investment across ATL and digital.
- Act as Sky's senior technical measurement authority, providing expert guidance on measurement design, KPI selection, campaign evaluation and interpretation of results.
- Lead the design and delivery of robust incrementality testing programmes, including strategic geo-tests and matched market experiments, ensuring outputs are statistically sound, commercially relevant and decision-ready.
- Support the evolution of Sky's digital measurement approach, working with Digital Marketing teams to ensure platform, attribution and incrementality signals are used appropriately and consistently to optimise campaigns and evaluate outcomes.
- Create a unified approach to interpreting evidence, integrating econometrics, testing, digital measurement, platform lift studies and campaign reporting into a coherent measurement framework.
- Build and develop market-leading measurement capability, leading a team of technical specialists and embedding measurement best practice across Media, Digital, Econometrics and agency partners.

Essential Criteria
- Deep expertise in experimental design, causal measurement and statistical analysis, with experience designing and evaluating large-scale media tests (including feasibility, power analysis, KPI definition and confidence assessment), ideally including geo-testing or matched market experiments.
- Strong understanding of media measurement across ATL and digital, including the strengths, limitations and appropriate application of econometrics, testing, attribution, platform measurement and campaign reporting.
- Proven experience developing measurement frameworks, standards or methodologies, with the ability to define consistent approaches to evaluating media effectiveness across multiple channels and evidence sources.
- Strong technical capability, including managing complex SQL queries across multiple data sources and using Python (or equivalent) to analyse, automate and interpret measurement outputs.
- Proven ability to translate complex measurement, testing and modelling outputs into clear, commercially actionable recommendations, with confidence influencing senior stakeholders and challenging interpretation where appropriate.
- Experience leading and developing analysts or technical specialists, building capability in measurement, statistical thinking and evidence-based decision-making.

Desirable skills and experience
- Experience working with econometric modelling / MMM outputs and integrating experimental findings into broader effectiveness frameworks.
- Experience designing measurement approaches for digital marketing, including attribution, platform measurement, incrementality and campaign optimisation
- Experience assessing and challenging third-party measurement methodologies, including agency, platform or measurement partner approaches.
- Experience applying advanced measurement techniques to strategic business questions, such as channel effectiveness, budget allocation, audience strategy or creative effectiveness.

Benefits and perks

There's one thing people can't stop talking about when it comes to life at Sky: the perks. Here's a taster:
- Free Sky TV including Sky Sports and Sky Cinema
- Pension package with up to 9% employer contribution
- Private healthcare with mental health support
- Aviva Digital GP and dental insurance
- Discounts on Sky products, including Sky Mobile, Sky Broadband, Sky Glass and Sky Protect
- Sharesave and Tech schemes
- A range of Sky VIP rewards and experiences

How you'll work

We've adopted a hybrid working approach to give more flexibility on where and how we work. The hybrid working expectations for this role are 3 days in the office per week.

Your office base

Osterley

Our Osterley Campus is a 10-minute walk from Syon Lane train station. Or you can hop on one of our free shuttle buses that run to and from Osterley, Gunnersbury, Ealing Broadway and South Ealing tube stations. There are also plenty of bike shelters and showers.

On campus, you'll find 13 subsidised restaurants, cafes, and a Waitrose. You can keep in shape at our subsidised gym, catch the latest shows and movies at our cinema, get your car washed, and even get pampered at our beauty salon.

Who we are

We're Sky, a leading media and entertainment company who connect millions with entertainment, sports, news and arts through innovative products and services. Working with us means you'll be bringing the joy of a better experience to more people, every day. All so we can do better and deliver better for our customers, colleagues and society.

We're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We're a Disability Confident Accredited Employer, and welcome and encourage applications from all candidates. We will look to ensure a fair and consistent experience for all and will make reasonable adjustments to support you where appropriate. Please flag any adjustments you need as early as you can.

Just so you know: if your application is successful, we'll ask you to complete a criminal record check. And depending on the role you have applied for and the nature of any convictions you may have, we might have to withdraw the offer.

title: Senior Trade Marketing Manager
description:
Ready to shape the future strategy of Trade Marketing for one of the world's most recognised drink brands?

The Advocate Group is proud to be partnering with a global leader within the drinks industry in their search for a Senior Trade Marketing Manager.

Sitting within the wider Commercial Strategy & Development division, this person will be responsible for defining the retail execution strategy across the EMEA&O region.

Leading a high-performing team, you'll shape the long-term Trade Marketing vision, influence how their portfolio is brought to life across diverse retail environments and international markets, and partner with senior stakeholders to accelerate commercial growth through best-in-class retail execution.

- Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team, building capability and future leaders.

- Drive strategic initiatives that elevate retail execution and shape the future of the shopper experience.

- A proven track record of leading, coaching and developing high-performing teams.
- A commercially minded strategic leader with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across a complex, international organisation.
- Experience operating across international or multi-market environments.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager & Content Creator

Location: Croydon, South London, CR0 4 RR, with travel to project sites
Pay: £16-£19+ per hour, depending on experience
Hours: Part-time, five contracted days per month, worked flexibly between 9am and 4pm. Additional days may be available
Travel: Regular UK and occasional international travel, including some evenings and weekends
Start date: Immediate

Are you a creative Social Media Manager & Content Creator with strong photography, videography and editing skills?

Join one of the UK s leading creative construction companies and capture the story behind exciting projects for television, film, theatre and live events.

About Scena

With more than 40 years in the industry, Scena Pro Ltd develops and builds sets for theatre, television, film, museums, conferences, exhibitions and live events worldwide.

Based at our Croydon workshop, our teams bring ambitious creative concepts to life. No two weeks are the same, giving you varied, visual content that audiences will want to see.

The Role

As our Social Media Manager & Content Creator, you will plan, produce and publish engaging content across Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Facebook and (url removed). You will also help develop longer-form YouTube content as our project film library grows.

This hands-on role involves filming and photography in our workshop and at installation sites across the UK and occasionally overseas.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Filming and photographing projects in the workshop and on location
- Editing reels, time-lapses, process videos and project reveals
- Planning a content calendar around live production schedules
- Writing captions and project copy in Scena s established voice
- Managing and publishing content across all social channels
- Monitoring engagement and responding to comments and messages
- Reporting monthly on content performance
- Producing project case studies and summaries
- Keeping the website, project pages and portfolio current
- Maintaining an organised media library
- Supplying content for award submissions, tenders and proposals
- Travelling to installations to capture projects first-hand

You will work closely with production and workshop teams, clients, marketing agencies and event organisers.

About You

We are looking for someone who has:
- Experience managing business social media accounts
- Confidence using a camera for photography and video
- Strong editing skills, particularly for short-form content
- A sharp eye for composition and visual storytelling
- Strong written English and the ability to follow an established brand voice
- Experience managing an effective content calendar
- The organisation to work around changing production schedules
- Confidence working independently on site and in a busy workshop
- Flexibility to travel and occasionally work evenings or weekends
- The ability to commute to our Croydon workshop

Experience in events, exhibitions, construction, design or theatre would be beneficial. Drone qualifications, After Effects, motion graphics, graphic design skills and a full UK driving licence would also be useful but are not essential.

What We Offer
- Hourly pay of £16-£19+, depending on experience
- Five contracted days per month with flexible scheduling
- Additional days as projects require
- Varied and visually exciting creative work
- Potential international travel
- A supportive and friendly working environment
- The opportunity to grow and make your mark in the industry

Apply today with your CV. Candidates selected for the next stage may be asked to provide photographs, a portfolio or examples of relevant work they have completed or led.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

To speak to the team, call (phone number removed) between 9am and 4.30pm, Monday to Friday.

Scena Pro Ltd is committed to equal opportunities and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

title: Marketing Science Lead
description:
As Media Measurement Lead, you will be Sky's senior technical owner for media measurement standards, responsible for building and embedding a unified measurement framework across ATL, digital, testing, econometrics and campaign reporting.

You will define the KPIs, methodology principles, evidential standards and confidence thresholds that determine how media performance is assessed, ensuring different evidence sources are interpreted consistently and used for the right decisions.

A core part of the role is designing and delivering robust strategic geo-tests and other incrementality experiments that provide credible evidence on what drives growth. You will lead the technical design of these tests end-to-end, from feasibility, market selection, power and KPI definition through to evaluation, interpretation and recommendation.

Reporting into the Head of Media Effectiveness, you will work closely with Econometrics, Digital Marketing, Media Planning, Media Strategy, Test & Learn and Publicis to connect measurement approaches into one practical framework for investment decision-making. This is a highly technical leadership role: the successful candidate will combine advanced statistical thinking, hands-on data capability and strong commercial judgement to protect the integrity of evidence while enabling confident media investment decisions.

What you'll do
- Own Sky's end-to-end media measurement framework, defining KPI standards, methodological principles, evidential standards and the measurement approaches used to evaluate media investment across ATL and digital.
- Act as Sky's senior technical measurement authority, providing expert guidance on measurement design, KPI selection, campaign evaluation and interpretation of results.
- Lead the design and delivery of robust incrementality testing programmes, including strategic geo-tests and matched market experiments, ensuring outputs are statistically sound, commercially relevant and decision-ready.
- Support the evolution of Sky's digital measurement approach, working with Digital Marketing teams to ensure platform, attribution and incrementality signals are used appropriately and consistently to optimise campaigns and evaluate outcomes.
- Create a unified approach to interpreting evidence, integrating econometrics, testing, digital measurement, platform lift studies and campaign reporting into a coherent measurement framework.
- Build and develop market-leading measurement capability, leading a team of technical specialists and embedding measurement best practice across Media, Digital, Econometrics and agency partners.

Essential Criteria
- Deep expertise in experimental design, causal measurement and statistical analysis, with experience designing and evaluating large-scale media tests (including feasibility, power analysis, KPI definition and confidence assessment), ideally including geo-testing or matched market experiments.
- Strong understanding of media measurement across ATL and digital, including the strengths, limitations and appropriate application of econometrics, testing, attribution, platform measurement and campaign reporting.
- Proven experience developing measurement frameworks, standards or methodologies, with the ability to define consistent approaches to evaluating media effectiveness across multiple channels and evidence sources.
- Strong technical capability, including managing complex SQL queries across multiple data sources and using Python (or equivalent) to analyse, automate and interpret measurement outputs.
- Proven ability to translate complex measurement, testing and modelling outputs into clear, commercially actionable recommendations, with confidence influencing senior stakeholders and challenging interpretation where appropriate.
- Experience leading and developing analysts or technical specialists, building capability in measurement, statistical thinking and evidence-based decision-making.

Desirable skills and experience
- Experience working with econometric modelling / MMM outputs and integrating experimental findings into broader effectiveness frameworks.
- Experience designing measurement approaches for digital marketing, including attribution, platform measurement, incrementality and campaign optimisation
- Experience assessing and challenging third-party measurement methodologies, including agency, platform or measurement partner approaches.
- Experience applying advanced measurement techniques to strategic business questions, such as channel effectiveness, budget allocation, audience strategy or creative effectiveness.

Benefits and perks

There's one thing people can't stop talking about when it comes to life at Sky: the perks. Here's a taster:
- Free Sky TV including Sky Sports and Sky Cinema
- Pension package with up to 9% employer contribution
- Private healthcare with mental health support
- Aviva Digital GP and dental insurance
- Discounts on Sky products, including Sky Mobile, Sky Broadband, Sky Glass and Sky Protect
- Sharesave and Tech schemes
- A range of Sky VIP rewards and experiences

How you'll work

We've adopted a hybrid working approach to give more flexibility on where and how we work. The hybrid working expectations for this role are 3 days in the office per week.

Your office base

Osterley

Our Osterley Campus is a 10-minute walk from Syon Lane train station. Or you can hop on one of our free shuttle buses that run to and from Osterley, Gunnersbury, Ealing Broadway and South Ealing tube stations. There are also plenty of bike shelters and showers.

On campus, you'll find 13 subsidised restaurants, cafes, and a Waitrose. You can keep in shape at our subsidised gym, catch the latest shows and movies at our cinema, get your car washed, and even get pampered at our beauty salon.

Who we are

We're Sky, a leading media and entertainment company who connect millions with entertainment, sports, news and arts through innovative products and services. Working with us means you'll be bringing the joy of a better experience to more people, every day. All so we can do better and deliver better for our customers, colleagues and society.

We're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We're a Disability Confident Accredited Employer, and welcome and encourage applications from all candidates. We will look to ensure a fair and consistent experience for all and will make reasonable adjustments to support you where appropriate. Please flag any adjustments you need as early as you can.

Just so you know: if your application is successful, we'll ask you to complete a criminal record check. And depending on the role you have applied for and the nature of any convictions you may have, we might have to withdraw the offer.

To be eligible for this role you are required to have the appropriate right to work in the UK.

To find out more about working with us, search on social media.
